## 2401 - 2454

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02401">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2401 FWV - Water correction not possible (gas is already dehydrated)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02401">

This exception is generated for a gas meter if the Dehydrated Gas field in the Volume Editor is set to "Yes" when FLOWCAL calculates the water vapor correction factor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02402">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2402 ANLC - Low observed temperature</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02402">

This exception is generated when the Observed Temperature on a liquid meter periodic record falls below the minimum value set in the Meter Editor. For example, the Min value for Observed Temperature is set to 50.000 but the value on the periodic record is 0.000.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02403">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2403 ANLC - High observed temperature</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02403">

This exception is generated when the Observed Temperature on a liquid meter periodic record exceeds the maximum value set in the Meter Editor. For example, the Max value for Observed Temperature is set to 85.000 but the value on the periodic record is 85.6.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02404">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2404 ANLC - Low observed pressure</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02404">

This exception is generated when the Observed Pressure on a liquid meter periodic record falls below the minimum value set in the Meter Editor. For example, the Min value for Observed Pressure is set to 10.000 but the value on the periodic record is 0.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02405">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2405 ANLC - High observed pressure</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02405">

This exception is generated when the Observed Pressure on a liquid meter periodic record exceeds the maximum value set in the Meter Editor. For example, the Max value for Observed Pressure is set to 200.000 but the value on the periodic record is 213.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02406">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2406 ANLC - Low S&amp;W percentage</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02406">

This exception is generated when the Sediment and Water % on a liquid meter analysis record falls below the minimum value set in the Meter Editor. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. For example, the Min value for S&W % is set to 0.005 but the value on the analysis record is 0.000.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02407">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2407 ANLC - High S&amp;W percentage</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02407">

This exception is generated when the Sediment and Water % on a liquid meter periodic record exceeds the maximum value set in the Meter Editor. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. For example, the Max value for S&W % is set to 2.000 but the value on the analysis record is 4.128.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02408">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2408 ANLC - Low S&amp;W volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02408">

This exception is generated when the Sediment and Water Volume on a liquid meter periodic record falls below the minimum value set in the Meter Editor. For example, the Min value for S&W Volume is set to 1.00 but the value on the periodic record is 0.03.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02409">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2409 ANLC - High S&amp;W volume</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02409">

This exception is generated when the Sediment and Water Volume on a liquid meter periodic record exceeds the maximum value set in the Meter Editor. For example, the Max value for S&W Volume is set to 20.00 but the value on the periodic record is 23.67.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02410">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2410 ANLC - Low mass heating value</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02410">

This exception is generated when mass heating value on a gas meter analysis record falls below the minimum value set in the Min/Max Values group box in the Meter Editor. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. For example, the Min value for mass heating value is set to 22500.000 but the value on the analysis record is 22496.096.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02411">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2411 ANLC - High mass heating value</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02411">

This exception is generated when mass heating value on a gas meter analysis record exceeds the maximum value set in the Min/Max Values group box in the Meter Editor. This exception is generated for the violating meter analysis record and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record. For example, the Max value for mass heating value is set to 23500.000 but the value on the analysis record is 23502.417.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02412">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2412 ANLC - Low shrinkage factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02412">

This exception is generated when a shrink factor value imported into a liquid meter is 0 or less. This exception is generated for the meter analysis record the shrink factor is imported into and will be displayed in the Volume Editor for all meter periodic records that are associated with the meter analysis record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02413">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2413 ANLC - High shrinkage factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02413">

This exception is generated when a shrink factor value of a liquid meter analysis is greater than 1.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02414">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2414 ANLC - Missing shrinkage factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02414">

This exception is generated when the shrink factor on a live oil liquid meter is null. The shrink factor value must be greater than 0 or <span style="font-family: 'Symbol'">£</span> 1. This exception does not apply to live oil meters that are marked as stabilized oil. (See: [Live Oil Management](../../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Tools%20Menu.md))

If the value for the shrink factor is 1 or \[NULL\], the value for the flash gas factor must be 0 or \[NULL\]. If the meter is a live oil meter and is not "Stabilized Oil", the shrink factor cannot be NULL.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02415">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2415 ANLC - Missing flash gas factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02415">

This exception is generated when the flash gas factor on a live oil liquid meter is null. The flash gas factor must be ≥ 0. This exception does not apply to live oil meters that are marked as stabilized oil. (See: [Live Oil Management](../../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Tools%20Menu.md))

If the value for the shrink factor is 1 or \[NULL\], the value for the flash gas factor must be 0 or \[NULL\]. If the meter is a live oil meter and is not "Stabilized Oil", the flash gas factor cannot be \[NULL\].

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02416">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2416 ANLC - Invalid flash gas factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02416">

This exception is generated when the flash gas factor of a liquid meter is less than zero.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02417">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2417 ANLC - Flash gas factor must be zero because shrinkage factor is 1</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02417">

This exception is generated when one of the following is true for a liquid meter:

- The shrink factor is one and the flash gas factor is not zero or null
- The shrink factor is null and the flash gas factor is not zero or null

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="2451">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2451 MKF - Variance between meter factor and baseline exceeds allowable unit difference</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="2451">

This exception is written when a liquid meter factor is outside the acceptable range of the established baseline meter factor. The acceptable range is calculated as:

("Baseline Meter Factor" - "Unit Difference")

to

("Baseline Meter Factor" + "Unit Difference").

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="2452">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2452 MKF - Variance between meter factor and baseline exceeds allowable percent difference</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="2452">

This exception is written when a liquid meter factor is outside the acceptable range of the established baseline meter factor. The acceptable range is calculated as:

"Baseline Meter Factor" \* (1 - "Percent Difference"/100)

to

"Baseline Meter Factor" \* (1 + "Percent Difference"/100)

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="2453">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2453 MKF - Variance between K-factor and baseline exceeds allowable unit difference</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="2453">

This exception is written when a liquid k factor is outside the acceptable range of the established baseline k factor. The acceptable range is calculated as:

("Baseline K Factor" - "Unit Difference")

to

("Baseline K Factor" + "Unit Difference")

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="2454">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2454 MKF - Variance between K-factor and baseline exceeds allowable percent difference</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="2454">

This exception is written when a liquid k factor is outside the acceptable range of the established baseline k factor. The acceptable range is calculated as

"Baseline K Factor" \* (1 - "Percent Difference"/100)

to

"Baseline K Factor" \* (1 + "Percent Difference"/100)

</div>
